name: Mark Shull

bio.statement: Shull's pamphlet statement lists service as a USMC/U.S. Army lieutenant colonel (retired) and as president of Shull Design and Development, Inc.
bio.excerpt: USMC/U.S. Army, Lieutenant Colonel (Ret.); President, Shull Design and Development, Inc.

bio.statement: Shull's pamphlet statement lists a B.S. from Oregon State University and a Command and General Staff College diploma.
bio.excerpt: Oregon State University, Bachelor of Science; Command and General Staff College, Strategy/Operations Diploma

bio.statement: Shull's pamphlet statement lists prior government experience as a Clackamas County commissioner.

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Shull opposes tolls on I-205 and says roads should be fixed without punishing daily drivers or local businesses.
positions.excerpt: No Tolls on I-205: Fix our infrastructure and roads without punishing daily drivers or harming local businesses.

positions.statement: Shull's pamphlet statement says he would stand for local control and reject Metro mandates he describes as costly.
positions.excerpt: Stop Metro Overreach: Stand firm for local control and reject costly, out-of-touch mandates that threaten our independence.

positions.statement: Shull's pamphlet statement pledges to cut spending he calls wasteful and to treat every tax dollar with respect.
positions.excerpt: Cut Wasteful Spending: Treat every tax dollar with absolute respect

positions.statement: In answers to an OPB questionnaire for the May 2026 primary, Shull calls property taxes a heavy burden, especially for seniors and working families on fixed incomes.
positions.excerpt: Property taxes are already a heavy burden here, especially for seniors and working families on fixed incomes.
